signals.name: vdc0d0_b6
signals.meaning: -> 0x11637C (gated by cal 0x364F3 b6) -> FFF8A8D1 / B406 / B452; meaning not determined

signals.name: vehicle_speed
signals.meaning: -> 0x118D9C -> FFF8B4C2 -> 0x06C21C -> FFF88BE8 (ECU vehicle speed, x17.78) and FFF99835 (km/h); fallback 10 km/h on VDC fault

signals.name: vdc_torque_request
signals.meaning: -> 0x116264 -> FFF8B470 (applied only while FFF8A89F b2 = byte4 bit1 and value > 10000 and FFF886AB b5); fallback 10000 (0 Nm)

signals.name: vdc0d3_counter
signals.meaning: rolling counter; U0416 if unchanged 200 passes

signals.name: accel_pedal_raw
signals.meaning: Accelerator pedal, channel-1 position through Accelerator Pedal Scaling (0..65535) high byte; fallback cal 0x573C4 on pedal fault

signals.name: rolling_counter
signals.meaning: 4-bit rolling counter 0..15, +1 per 10 ms (= per frame); 0..7 in variants 0

signals.name: mil_request
signals.meaning: MIL requested: FFF99809 b3 (DTC confirmed, MIL on) OR FFF88E69 b1 (flashing-MIL DTC)

signals.name: etc_fault
signals.meaning: Copy of FFF8A2B8 b7: electronic-throttle fault with motor drive off (Phase 13 TE)

signals.name: clutch_switch_latched
signals.meaning: MT only: FFF88E62 b1 (pin PA14, active low) latched while MT coding FFF88ADA b7, released after cal 0x5780F passes; clutch pedal switch (inferred)

signals.name: engine_speed
signals.meaning: Engine speed, 1 rpm/bit (CD54 = rpm x 5.12), 14 bits

signals.name: dtc_setting_off
signals.meaning: Set by UDS 0x85 ControlDTCSetting 0x02 (off) in session 2/3 (0x0B54AC); cleared at reset/0x0B7730

signals.name: cruise_virtual_pedal
signals.meaning: Cruise module pedal-equivalent request (B9AC, written by 0x168864); 0 when not cruising

signals.name: accel_pedal_effective
signals.meaning: Pedal used by the torque request: FFF88A5E, or max(pedal, B9AC) while cruise (FFF88E12 b1)

signals.name: throttle_opening
signals.meaning: Throttle opening: 888A4 = FFF88A3A x 25600 / cal 0x35AFE (43515); 255 ~ 100 % (scale inferred)

signals.name: throttle_closed
signals.meaning: Throttle byte FFF8CD77 <= cal 0x3550C (3), +cal 0x3550D (2) hysteresis: throttle (nearly) closed

signals.name: status_89AB6
signals.meaning: FFF89AB6 != 0; 89AB6 set/cleared by a serial handshake in 0x090E8A/0x09203A (not decoded)

signals.name: pin_PA2
signals.meaning: Raw discrete input A29A b4 = pin PA2 (active low) masked by cal 0x5693A (=0)

signals.name: accessory_load_flag
signals.meaning: FFF8A8A0 b0, or (coding FFF811DC != 0x5A) input FFF88BC6 b4 (pin PA4); the flag that enables Idle Air Adder (CAN 0x280 Stage)

signals.name: torque_request
signals.meaning: Driver torque request after the external limit (AEA6) x AEA0 (=1.0 stock): 10000 + 10 x Nm; with the pedal released: 10000 - 10 x friction (B46C)

signals.name: torque_actual
signals.meaning: Estimated engine torque: DAM-weighted torque-from-load (B490/B4A2) through 05D3D8/05D3E4, minus losses AF62 and an idle term; 10000 + 10 x Nm, floor 0

signals.name: engine_speed_filtered
signals.meaning: Filtered engine speed (CE9C, weight B73E); with an AT it tracks the TCM speed FFF8924E (0x149); 0 when FFF88A28 b1 clear or engine not rotating

signals.name: pedal_flag_88C64b4
signals.meaning: Copy of FFF88C64 b4 (pedal module 0x09F282, not decoded)

signals.name: gear_mt
signals.meaning: Gear 1..6 as binary; 7 when neutral (FFF88ADA b6); hold otherwise; 0 when not MT

signals.name: flag_88E0Eb0
signals.meaning: From 88A27 b0, 88ADA b3, 89010 b0, module voltage 88A7E, coolant 88A44, A82E b7

signals.name: crank_or_low_voltage
signals.meaning: 0 only when 88A27 b0 and 88ADA b3 clear, module voltage FFF88A7E > 0x6666 and a start timer (cal 0x35B06) expired

signals.name: below_rev_limit
signals.meaning: rpm < AED4 + cal 0x3552C and (rpm < A62E x 128 + cal 0x3552E or A63D b0 clear)

signals.name: drive_mode_applied
signals.meaning: SI-Drive mode applied (A8C3): mode1 (default) -> b1b0=11, mode2 (Sport) -> b0, mode3 (Intelligent) -> b1, mode4 (Sport Sharp) -> b2; positions inferred from the stock maps (Phase 22)

signals.name: charging_flag_AA6Bb7
signals.meaning: Charging-control module 0x13741C status bit (sent while cal 0x57584 b4 = 0)

signals.name: booster_sensor_fault
signals.meaning: Brake-booster pressure sensor FFF88D0C out of range low/high (0x071B82, cal 0x57585 b5)

signals.name: cruise_switch_code
signals.meaning: Cruise lever switches FFF88EC9 b0/b1/b3/b2 one-hot-ish: b3 = b0 or b3 alone, b4 = b1 or b3 alone, b5 = b2 alone (held otherwise)

signals.name: drive_cycle_done
signals.meaning: Set once counters 89D3A >= 600, 89D3C >= 300, 89D3E >= 30 (OBD driving-cycle criteria, inferred)

signals.name: cruise_switch_taps
signals.meaning: Cruise: b4 raise-switch tap, b5 raise edge, b6 lower-switch tap, b7 lower edge (Phase 18 C)

signals.name: max_available_torque
signals.meaning: (T_CAN - friction) x 0.625: T_CAN = Engine Torque from Load (CAN, DAM 1.0/0) blended by DAM; 255 = saturated

signals.name: start_counter
signals.meaning: Backup-RAM 8-bit wrap counter, +1 on each rising edge of FFF8AB8C b0 (engine-start event, 0x1739C8) in normal mode (AC78 = 0)

signals.name: warmup_counter
signals.meaning: Same for FFF8AB8D b0 (coolant-based event, 0x1739F4): warm-up cycle counter (inferred)

signals.name: coding_byte
signals.meaning: Bit-permuted copy of cal 0x58B7A (0x0A) -> 0x24 constant on this ROM

signals.name: cruise_active
signals.meaning: Cruise controlling (max(pedal torque, cruise torque) used)

signals.name: can_fault_latch
signals.meaning: Latched (until reset) when 88DD4 b4/b5/b6 (0x161 group U-codes) or A8A4 b3/b5

signals.name: cruise_unavailable
signals.meaning: 0 only when meter flags 811E1 b4 and b2 set and no fault (88BB2 b0, 88E13 b4/b0, A8A4 b1)

signals.name: vdc_flag_inverted
signals.meaning: Inverted output of 0x11B5A4 (inputs incl. VDC request 888B6, MAP, coolant)

signals.name: drive_mode_requested
signals.meaning: Requested/accepted mode A8C2: bit1 = A8C2 in {1,2}, bit2 = in {1,3}, bit3 = (A8C2 == 4)

signals.name: tcm148_gear
signals.meaning: -> 0x1166F0 -> FFF8A8D5 (1..6, 0xD, 0xE, 0; others hold) -> FFF8A899 (0x08254C gear path, ignition 0x0DE0E0, cruise)

signals.name: tcm149_b1_lo
signals.meaning: b4-6 -> 0x10F464 -> FFF8A88F (0/2/4 blend request; read by torque, ignition, idle, boost)

signals.name: tcm149_idle_target
signals.meaning: minimum idle target in 0x0F222C (B240 = max(B22C, x*1024/25))

signals.name: tcm149_torque_limit
signals.meaning: used by 0x117778 only when FFF88B80 b2 is set, which no variant-1 frame sets; fallback cal 0x572D0 = 0x55

signals.name: can_restart_req
signals.meaning: CAN restart (start-state 5); many readers (0x06A064, 0x06A166, fuel, ignition)

signals.name: m161_switch_code
signals.meaning: 0x10F504 -> FFF8A895 = CAN cruise switch code (used when FFF811E1 b4 and cal 0x36584 = 1)

signals.name: m188_code
signals.meaning: -> 0x1106D0 -> FFF8A89D (b0 + 2*b1 + 4*b2, 0 if b1 and b2) -> 0x11A060: FFF8A8A1 b3 = (code 5 for cal 0x35A94 = 70 passes)

signals.name: ac280_b0_bit0
signals.meaning: -> 0x1195AC (with FFF8A297 b2) -> FFF88B8B b0 = A/C request input of 0x080088 / 0x121B90 (inferred)

signals.name: ac280_b2_bit7
signals.meaning: FFF88B8E is read by 0x0EE338, 0x0F7618, 0x1CFD2E (bit not separated)

signals.name: ac280_b3
signals.meaning: radiator fan duty table input 05C998 (0x0F70B4, fan module 0x0F7618, off in stock)

signals.name: ac280_b6_bit0
signals.meaning: forces FFF8A8C6 = cal 0x35A85; set to 1 on frame loss

signals.name: fuel_flow
signals.meaning: 1000 x cal 0x35B32 (49917) x C230 x rpm_raw x 2.6375e-11/60 x cal 0x35B34/32768, C230 = sum of the 8 injector pulse words x 0.8 / 4; 0 when engine not rotating; clamp 65535

signals.name: oil_temp
signals.meaning: Engine oil temperature (88A9D = degC+50); 40 (0 degC) when FFF88E2B b5 (oil sensor fault)

signals.name: coolant_temp
signals.meaning: Coolant temperature (Coolant Temp Sensor Scaling, degC+50); 0xFF when FFF88E28 b1 (sensor fault)

signals.name: map
signals.meaning: Manifold pressure, 2 kPa/bit, first-order filtered (cal 0x3650A); 7 when FFF88E28 b3 (MAP fault); init 0x33

signals.name: flag_888A7b1
signals.meaning: Output of 0x11A9D8 (pedal, speed, drive mode, rpm inputs)

signals.name: drive_mode_req_bits
signals.meaning: b1/b2 = A8C2 code (as 0x144), b3 = A8C0 in {2..5}

signals.name: cruise_lamp_main
signals.meaning: Cruise indicator (state 0xA0 standby, blink timer cal 0x409BC)

signals.name: flag_88E14b0
signals.meaning: 1 with MT coding, else coolant FFF8CD65 < cal 0x35518 (0)

signals.name: elec_load_flag
signals.meaning: 0 when A290 b5 clear and load word B458 (CAN 0x370) below cal 0x35AA0 (hyst 0x35AA2)

signals.name: cruise_set_speed
signals.meaning: Cruise set speed B9FC (km/h x 128) rounded; x1000/1609 (mph) when A8A7 b0 (mph meter); 0 when main switch off

signals.name: gear_calc
signals.meaning: Gear 1..6 binary from 0x114230 (20 ms gear logic; shift-indicator gear, inferred)

signals.name: flag_88E13b1
signals.meaning: 0 on this ROM (cal 0x57585 b3 = 0 holds init)

signals.name: maint_flag_811E0
signals.meaning: Backup-RAM flag from 0x11BB08 (counters 1148C/1148E, A8D1); maintenance-type reminder (guess)

signals.name: mil_code
signals.meaning: 88E69 b1/b2 -> 4 (flash phase on), 1 (lamp off / flash off phase), 0 (steady on); init 1

signals.name: booster_pressure_raw
signals.meaning: Brake-booster pressure sensor A/D high byte (Phase 18 D)

signals.name: baro
signals.meaning: Barometric pressure (88A36, kPa x 256 inferred), clamp 0..255

signals.name: battery_current
signals.meaning: (raw - 1875000)/4 of LIN battery-sensor word FFF89074 (I = raw/1000 - 2000 A, from the SOC integrator 0x139798), clamp -125..+125 A; 0xFFFF invalid

signals.name: lin_fault_flag
signals.meaning: 89245 b2 or b1 (LIN status) while cal 0x57584 b4 = 0

signals.name: m370_word
signals.meaning: -> 0x114AD0 -> FFF8B458 (zero when byte3 bit0) = idle air adder (electrical load, inferred) in 0x0ECAE0, 0x0801B8, 0x111AB8

signals.name: ambient_temp_raw
signals.meaning: 0x1FFF = startup/invalid, 0x1FFE = frame lost; filtered FFF8924A (0x071DC6) checked by P0072/P0073 (0x071E14: <3523 -> P0073, >4873 -> P0072)

signals.name: m660_dist
signals.meaning: 0xFFFFFF = invalid; last valid FFF8900C -> 0x110108 -> FFF8C228 (monotonic, DTC record stamp)

signals.name: rolling_counter_162
signals.meaning: Rolling counter (frozen check only). 0x162 is received instead of 0x188 by ROMs on the alternate network table; no other bit of it is decoded.

signals.name: value_142
signals.meaning: 16-bit ECU value FFF8B4B2 (low 15 bits, low byte first). 0x142 is sent instead of 0x362 by ROMs on the alternate network table.

signals.name: flag_142_A9A2b6
signals.meaning: FFF8A9A2 b6 (the byte whose b7 is the A/C compressor flag in 0x140).

signals.name: value_361_b5_6
signals.meaning: 16-bit ECU value FFF8B454, low byte first. Sent only when cal 0x57584 b4 is set (the Forester ROMs on the alternate table); otherwise bytes 5-7 are 0.

signals.name: value_361_b7
signals.meaning: ECU value FFF8A8E0; same option as bytes 5-6.

signals.name: battery_soc_low_nibble
signals.meaning: Low 4 bits of the battery state-of-charge byte (the value in byte 3). Packed by the 2017-2018 and Levorg ROMs; LF75404S leaves bits 4-7 at 0.

signals.name: network_variant0_flag
signals.meaning: FFF88E0C b3: set only when the ECU runs network variant 0, so always 0 on these cars (all select variant 1).

signals.name: lin_battery_b0
signals.meaning: LIN battery-sensor block, low nibble of FFF893A6. 0x6FC is sent every 100 ms by ROMs whose table has it in mailbox 15 (they do not receive 0x15A).

signals.name: rx_0d1_b3_2_2
signals.meaning: Used only by the ROMs listed; meaning not determined.

signals.name: rx_161_b5_7_7
signals.meaning: Used only by the ROMs listed; meaning not determined.

signals.name: rx_188_b6_6_6
signals.meaning: Used only by the ROMs listed; meaning not determined.

signals.name: rx_368_b0_7_7
signals.meaning: Used only by the ROMs listed; meaning not determined.

signals.name: rx_3d1_b7_2_6
signals.meaning: Used only by the ROMs listed; meaning not determined.
